rules.title: ARR activity eligibility
rules.logic: Project activities must establish, increase or restore vegetative cover in non-forest areas; area-based activities may enhance stocks in existing forest cover only where the forest has not been managed for wood products in the previous ten years.

rules.title: Area-based leakage module
rules.logic: Area-based projects apply VMD0054 to quantify leakage.

rules.title: Census approach core conditions
rules.logic: Census-based projects use direct planting, max 50 planting units/ha, complete census at t=0, project-method additionality/baseline, and no leakage deduction where land use is maintained.

rules.title: Mutually exclusive approach applicability
rules.logic: Each project activity instance must fully meet either area-based or census-based applicability; mixed projects require clearly separated instances with at least a 10 m buffer.

rules.title: General applicability conditions
rules.logic: All projects must increase vegetative cover, keep mixed approaches non-overlapping, fix the quantification approach for the crediting period, document the earliest start-date trigger, and use a multiple-project-activity design on organic soils/wetlands.

rules.title: Area-based t0 before site preparation
rules.logic: Where site preparation triggers the start date, t=0 estimates for all significant pools must be established before preparation and no more than two years before start; remote sensing is limited to pre-existing woody biomass if plots were unavailable.

rules.title: Remote sensing t0 limitation
rules.logic: Remote sensing may establish t=0 only for pre-existing above- and belowground woody biomass; disturbed significant pools without t=0 measurement make the project ineligible unless conservatively excludable.

rules.title: Area-based t0 after land-use-change start
rules.logic: Where start is a land-use-change date or preparation did not significantly reduce monitored pools, t=0 estimates must be established within two years after start, using plot sampling for all significant pools and evidence that preparation did not significantly reduce them.

rules.title: Leakage not de minimis
rules.logic: Area-based leakage must be monitored and quantified using VMD0054 and must not be assumed de minimis.

rules.title: Census planting, land use, density and census
rules.logic: Census-based activities must use direct planting, maintain pre-project land use, stay at or below 50 planting units/ha with proportional scaling, and establish N by complete census at t=0.

rules.title: Census replanting cap
rules.logic: Dead planting units may be replanted provided N does not exceed 50 live project planting units per hectare.

rules.title: Planting-unit identification
rules.logic: Each census planting unit must be identifiable by GPS spacing at least equal to positional accuracy or by a durable unique physical marker.

rules.title: Missing unit mortality assumption
rules.logic: A planting unit that cannot be located at monitoring is conservatively assumed dead.

rules.title: Census land eligibility
rules.logic: Census activity must occur in areas with less than 10% pre-existing woody cover and/or qualifying continuous cropping, settlements or other lands.

rules.title: Project soil-disturbance limits
rules.logic: Project-related soil disturbance is permitted at planting; localized planting disturbance may exceed 25 cm, but soil inversion must not exceed 25 cm and may occur only once in the crediting period.

rules.title: Area-based exclusions
rules.logic: Area-based projects are ineligible on recently managed forest, where clearing involves timber harvest or native-ecosystem degradation, or where planting fewer than 50 units/ha could use census-based approach.

rules.title: Census-based exclusions
rules.logic: Census projects are ineligible where similar-purpose woody biomass was removed in the prior 10 years or project soil inversion exceeds 25 cm.

rules.title: Non-overlap and significance test
rules.logic: Mixed approaches must have non-overlapping accounting boundaries and Appendix 2 must be applied to test significance of optional pools and GHG sources.

rules.title: Area-based carbon-pool inclusion
rules.logic: Above- and belowground woody biomass are mandatory; optional pools become mandatory where project activity significantly reduces them or specified disturbance/harvesting conditions apply; harvested wood products are excluded.

rules.title: Census accounting boundary and pools
rules.logic: Each census planting unit has a 10 m radius accounting buffer; buffers may overlap within an instance but not another instance; only above- and belowground woody biomass are included.

rules.title: GHG-source inclusion
rules.logic: Project CH4 and N2O from biomass burning and N2O from nitrogen fertilizer may be significant and are included; baseline sources and fossil-fuel burning are conservatively excluded or de minimis as specified.
